headline: Reported OCS injuries rose from 2023 to 2024

source.name: BSEE Offshore Incident Statistics, Injuries cards

text_alternative: The BSEE calendar-year cards list 203 reported injuries in 2023 and 223 in 2024 across the Outer Continental Shelf (OCS). These counts are not a GoM-only subset or an exposure-adjusted risk rate. No reference limit was supplied.
